subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and merge these exact third-party GitHub Action revisions in workflows that receive repository and external-service credentials?
rationale: The patch is mechanical and SHA-pinned, but approval determines whether new upstream executable code may run with sensitive workflow credentials; that trust boundary cannot be inferred from tests or Dependabot metadata.

options.title: Approve reviewed pins
options.body: Accept the upstream revisions after a CI/security owner confirms the credential-bearing action changes are acceptable, then rebase and merge with required checks.

options.title: Split privileged action bumps
options.body: Land only low-privilege action updates now and send the GitHub App, Docker, and Codex action changes through a separate security-reviewed PR.

options.title: Hold current action versions
options.body: Close or defer this batch if the repository is not ready to approve the revised privileged actions.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed pins
recommendation.body: Accept the upstream revisions after a CI/security owner confirms the credential-bearing action changes are acceptable, then rebase and merge with required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate based on adjacent OpenClaw CI and release history.
